mechanism: Tetrabenazine can cause orthostatic hypotension and hypotension, which may be additive with captopril's blood pressure-lowering effects; additionally, tetrabenazine inhibits CYP2D6 which may affect captopril metabolism.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly during concurrent use; educate patient on orthostatic precautions and report symptoms of excessive hypotension; dose adjustment may be needed.
